_note: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH. Kotlin (domain) and Python (training) both load this file. The eight features below are the real vector used by FeatureVector/FeatureVectorFactory (SRS-SOC-2026-V1 section 9), in the order the model consumes them. Update this file and retrain; never reorder in code alone.

features.name: munsell_value
features.description: Munsell value derived from calibrated Lab (FeatureVector.munsellValue)

features.name: ndvi_satellite
features.description: Sentinel-2 NDVI (FeatureVector.ndviSatellite). Optional: with no Sentinel token the app supplies a DEFAULT value and flags the result as degraded; the model must be trained with this fallback (see fallback_features_trained).
